'''Hemmings''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was stationed at the [[Lower Markaran Outpost|Markaran Imperial Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
